name: OMC25
brief: Organic molecules packed into periodic cells of up to 300 atoms, spanning about a dozen elements. Aimed at polymorph ranking and crystal-structure prediction for pharmaceutical applications.
curator: Meta FAIR-Chem (Gharakhanyan, Barroso-Luque, Marom, Ulissi, Sriram et al.)
elements: H, B, C, N, O, F, Si, P, S, Cl, Br, I (12)
paperTitle: Open Molecular Crystals 2025 (OMC25) Dataset and Models
primaryPaper: Gharakhanyan et al., Open Molecular Crystals 2025 (OMC25) Dataset and Models, arXiv:2508.02651 (2025).
howToGet: Gated download on Hugging Face at facebook/OMC25 (CC-BY 4.0, access request required); provided as ASE-DB lmdb files.
